name: Split screen: three-way split
when: The voice lists three names ("streets, tracks and off-road"). One slanted panel per name; the stack re-flows to thirds and every name stays centred in its panel. Each panel shows its name: a shot of that very thing, or, for a name no footage can show (loading, haptics, audio), a clean white icon (`icon1` to `icon3`) over a GTA VI mood shot that fits the word, lightly blurred (`| gblur=sigma=9:steps=2`), so the footage is still recognisable and the icon stays readable (validated 17 Nov). Never a shot unrelated to the name with nothing on it. The shots play inside the scene; it ends on the three-way split (cut to the next shot).
anchor: Each panel lands on its name: `in2` on the second, `in3` on the third.

vars.shot1: the first shot: a 1920x1080 30 fps video in assets/, cut to start where it should start; it plays for the whole scene. It must show the first name; when no footage shows it, leave it empty and set icon1
vars.shot2: the second shot: plays from `in2` to the end (it shows the second name, or set icon2)
vars.shot3: the third shot: plays from `in3` to the end (it shows the third name, or set icon3)
vars.icon1: a clean white icon for a name footage can't show: loading (a spinning circle), haptics (a controller that buzzes), audio (headphones with sound waves); empty = the shot alone. What it sits on: `iconbg`
vars.icon2: the same for the second panel
vars.icon3: the same for the third panel
vars.loader: the loading circle: A (a steady arc) or B (an arc that grows and shrinks)
vars.label1: the first name, as the voice says it (shown in capitals, 8 characters at most so a third holds it)
vars.label2: the second name (8 characters at most)
vars.label3: the third name (10 characters at most: the third panel is the widest, VICE CITY fits)
vars.in2: seconds after the start: when the voice says the second name
vars.in3: seconds after the start: when the voice says the third name (at least 0.5 s after `in2`)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the scene ends (a cut), at least 0.6 s after `in3`
vars.iconbg: what an icon sits on: footage (the default and the validated look, 17 Nov 2026): that panel's shot plays under the icon with a soft shadow behind it. Give each icon panel a GTA VI mood shot that fits its word (a driver at the wheel for haptics, a party for audio, a road ahead for loading), cut with ` | gblur=sigma=9:steps=2` (light blur: still recognisable, icon readable). black: a black panel with white gutters, only when no shot fits the word (the owner found all-black panels 'too goofy, too aggressive'). badge: the shot sharp, the icon on a dark round badge (not picked). Without a shot in that panel: black.

changed: The shots are file values and play from their own start (cut each file where it should begin). The ground behind the scene is gone: the shots always cover the frame. 16 Nov 2026: icon panels (owner: the footage under 'haptics / 3D audio / loading' had no link to the words; 'a black screen with a white loading circle that spins, clean: we'd get it straight away'). 17 Nov 2026: `iconbg` (owner: the black panels look "too goofy, too aggressive": try a blurred background, footage behind the icon). Variants B (heavy blur), C (light blur) and D (sharp + badge) shown; the owner picked C ("light blur: you can still recognise the footage, and the icon stays readable... the best version out of all of them"), so footage with sigma 9 is the default.
